title: BTI mobile plant phenotyping system: Image analysis protocol
author: Li'ang Yu

steps.title: Set up Conda environment
steps.instruction: Create a clean conda environment named plantcv, install PlantCV version 3.12.1, and activate the environment.

substeps.instruction: conda create -n plantcv
conda install -n plantcv plantcv=3.12.1
conda activate plantcv

steps.title: Verify PlantCV installation
steps.instruction: Download the two example Jupyter notebooks from the GitHub repository, open one in Jupyter, and run the first code chunk to import the required libraries and confirm that PlantCV loads without error.

substeps.instruction: Download notebooks from https://github.com/Leon-Yu0320/BTI-Plant-phenotyping/tree/main/notebook_example
In Jupyter, run: import os, import numpy as np, import argparse, from plantcv import plantcv as pcv

steps.title: Prepare example images and options
steps.instruction: Download example images, set the file path in a Python options class, enable debug plotting, and read the image with PlantCV.

substeps.instruction: Download images from https://github.com/Leon-Yu0320/BTI-Plant-phenotyping/tree/main/images_example
Edit the options class so that self.image points to the local image file (e.g., C:/Users/Desktop/raspiS_cameraB_127120012.jpg)
Set self.debug = "plot", self.writeimg = True, self.result = "./Results", self.outdir = "./Results"
Instantiate options: args = options()
Set global debug: pcv.params.debug = args.debug
Read image: img, path, filename = pcv.readimage(filename=args.image)

steps.title: Process multi‑plant images
steps.instruction: Apply position correction, white‑balance, colour‑space conversion, masking, ROI definition, and phenotype extraction to a multi‑plant image.

substeps.instruction: Shift image left 80 px: imgs = pcv.shift_img(img=img, number=80, side='left')
Shift resulting image up 20 px: img1 = pcv.shift_img(img=imgs, number=20, side='top')
White‑balance using ROI (x=1400, y=900, width=100, height=100): img1 = pcv.white_balance(img, roi=(1400,900,100,100))
Convert to LAB channels:
l = pcv.rgb2gray_lab(rgb_img=img1, channel='l')
a = pcv.rgb2gray_lab(rgb_img=img1, channel='a')
b = pcv.rgb2gray_lab(rgb_img=img1, channel='b')
Create binary mask from the 'a' channel (threshold=110, max_value=255, object_type='dark'): img_binary = pcv.threshold.binary(gray_img=a, threshold=110, max_value=255, object_type='dark')
Define a rectangular ROI covering the whole image (x=45, y=40, h=1900, w=1900): roi_contour, roi_hierarchy = pcv.roi.rectangle(img=img1, x=45, y=40, h=1900, w=1900)

Define circular ROIs for individual plants (center at (285,285), radius=160 px, spacing=(475,475), 4 rows × 4 columns): rois1, roi_hierarchy1 = pcv.roi.multi(img=img1, coord=(285,285), radius=160, spacing=(475,475), nrows=4, ncols=4)

Extract phenotypes for each plant (leaf edge overlay, numeric ordering 0‑15, skip empty pots) and verify that leaf area is largely covered by the blue edge lines using pcv.analyze_object or equivalent functions.

steps.title: Process side‑view images
steps.instruction: Perform optional position adjustment, white‑balance, colour‑space thresholding, mask application, ROI definition, and phenotype extraction for side‑view images.

substeps.instruction: If needed, shift/rotate the image using the same pcv.shift_img commands as in the multi‑plant protocol (optional).
White‑balance using histogram mode with ROI [450,1250,100,100]: corrected_img = pcv.white_balance(img=img, mode='hist', roi=[450,1250,100,100])
Visualise colour spaces (optional): colorspace_img = pcv.visualize.colorspaces(rgb_img=corrected_img)
Threshold the 'a' channel (threshold=105, max_value=np.max(a), object_type='dark'): a_thresh = pcv.threshold.binary(gray_img=a, threshold=105, max_value=np.max(a), object_type='dark')
Threshold the 'V' channel (threshold=220, max_value=np.max(a), object_type='dark'): v_thresh = pcv.threshold.binary(gray_img=v, threshold=220, max_value=np.max(a), object_type='dark')
Combine the two binary images: v_a = pcv.logical_or(bin_img1=v_thresh, bin_img2=a_thresh)
Apply the combined mask to the original image (mask colour = white): masked = pcv.apply_mask(img=img, mask=v_a, mask_color="white")
Define a rectangular ROI on the masked image (x=450, y=400, h=1000, w=1120): roi1, roi_hierarchy = pcv.roi.rectangle(img=masked, x=450, y=400, h=1000, w=1120)

Extract objects within the ROI (using previously identified object contours id_objects and hierarchy obj_hierarchy): roi_objects, hierarchy3, kept_mask, obj_area = pcv.roi_objects(img=img, roi_contour=roi1, roi_hierarchy=roi_hierarchy, object_contour=id_objects, obj_hierarchy=obj_hierarchy, roi_type="partial")
Analyze each object to obtain leaf‑area phenotype (edge overlay): analysis_image = pcv.analyze_object(img=img, obj=obj, mask=mask)
